hero.description: We are committed to safeguarding your privacy and managing your data with strict confidentiality.

meta.entity: Musanid Aser for Supply and Commercial Brokerage

lead.title: Our Commitment to Privacy & Confidentiality
lead.text: At Musanid Aser for Supply & Commercial Brokerage, we are dedicated to protecting the privacy of our website visitors and clients, and handling all information provided through the website with strict confidentiality and diligence.

collection.title: Information Collected Through Inquiries & Forms
collection.text: When using our quote request form or contacting us, certain information may be collected including entity name, contact representative name, mobile number, email address, request details, specifications, quantities, estimated budget, and delivery details.

purpose.title: Purpose of Utilizing Collected Data
purpose.text: This data is utilized solely for reviewing requests, preparing appropriate quotations, communicating with clients, and following up on supply and commercial brokerage services.
points: Reviewing requests and evaluating requirements with technical and commercial accuracy.
Preparing competitive quotations and comparing qualified sourcing options.
Direct communication with the client for clarifications and updates.
Monitoring and coordinating service delivery phases related to supply and commercial brokerage.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Data Processing
legalBasis.text: Data processing is conducted based on the data subject's consent when submitted through the website, and for purposes related to reviewing requests, communication, and delivering requested services, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

retention.title: Data Retention Period
retention.text: We retain personal data for the duration necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was collected or as required by relevant regulations, after which it is disposed of securely to prevent unauthorized access or unlawful recovery.

rights.title: Rights of the Data Subject
rights.text: In accordance with applicable regulations, the data subject has the right to request access to their personal data, obtain it in a clear format, request its correction or update, request its destruction when statutory conditions apply, and withdraw consent to its processing where applicable.
items: Request access to personal data and obtain it in a clear, readable format.
Request correction, updating, and verification of personal data.
Request destruction of personal data when statutory conditions apply.
Withdraw consent to data processing where applicable in accordance with regulations.

sharing.title: Non-Sale of Data & Commercial Confidentiality
sharing.text: We do not sell or share client data with any third party for marketing purposes. Essential information may only be shared with verified suppliers or relevant parties when strictly necessary to assess requests or execute services, and only to the extent required.

security.title: Data Security & Protective Safeguards
security.text: We are committed to taking appropriate measures to protect information against unauthorized access, disclosure, or unlawful use.

external.title: External Links & Third-Party Platforms
external.text: Our website may include links to external channels such as WhatsApp or email services, which operate under their respective privacy policies.

consent.title: Consent to Privacy Terms
consent.text: By using this website and submitting your data through our contact and inquiry forms, you agree to the use of your data for the purposes described in this policy.
